request.head: integration/python-inventory-capture-v2
request.title: Integrate reviewed opt-in Python inventory capture with source registry v2
request.body:
从 PR138 当前固定 head 2d297de0e5c7776c358ab49ab2072659ac03c8fc 开始，原样采纳 PR139 final capture e3b932ed4b1e197022c0902fd4c11af3e87ae87e。原 source8d2b312、full review a17f05d（含红色 partial-find test/report/logs）及 fixed delta review1fe4dc5 全部逐byte保留；原失败断言在新树直接通过。接受范围仅 opt-in Linux/statx、EntireProject/no exclusions/全部.git 的 bounded capture→AST→model 声明准入。

新增显式 python-inventory-20261004-v2 registry，独立重建 approved50a493 的原 source union + exact capture delta + 固定新fixture，完整764 crate/Cargo/lock inputs及hash；CI显式选择v2。保留 da896b source guard/v1 approved50a493 manifest 与 2d297 P0 historical materialization anchor277f249。无HEAD/latest自授权；packing/e3/P0及base2d成功CI37174586283保持historical，不认证当前capture质量。

新3项实际filesystem→真实AST→borrowed model组合fixture，独立literal spans、全scope binding/marker/collision、配置与资源/累计output拒绝。当前112 scoped Rust tests + 30 source controls + 14 harmless historical P0 controls通过；strict workspace all-target Clippy/build、fmt、architecture/source/plan guards通过。初次scoped test compile diskfull（尚未执行tests）原日志保留，仅清理可重建incremental cache后原argv重跑通过。metadata通过tasks.json→generator --write→noargs；192任务状态不变。

Fixed product780502322816e4fd1d61d8f77a98d7d6b635d9fb；docs/registry5802d9273395c9ac6cfe91cc78f96273becc4559。完整provenance/命令/hash/边界：artifacts/checkpoints/python-inventory-integration-20261004/README.md。

无新DB/MCP/retrieval输出、UID/qname/search/parser extraction/scorer/gold/weights/budgets变化。非runtime publication/质量/原子/RSS认证。未跑formalDEV/100k/excludedruntime/broad/private42/GCWALfaults、实际bindmount或OS设置变更；无merge/deploy。
